p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=sorted((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0)
    def cross(o,a,b): return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])
    lo=[]
    for q in pts:
        while len(lo)>=2 and cross(lo[-2],lo[-1],q)<=0: lo.pop()
        lo.append(q)
    hi=[]
    for q in reversed(pts):
        while len(hi)>=2 and cross(hi[-2],hi[-1],q)<=0: hi.pop()
        hi.append(q)
    hull=lo[:-1]+hi[:-1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=0: continue
        inside=True
        for i,a in enumerate(hull):
          b=hull[(i+1)%len(hull)]
          if cross(a,b,(r,c))<0: inside=False; break
        if inside: out[r][c]=3
    return out
''')
